# The .ino.cpp file is generated by PlatformIO's Arduino preprocessor from the
# root sketch copied into this staging directory by prepare_idf_sources.py.
set(APP_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/..")

# Vendored WeirdIKE (IKEv2/IPsec core) -- flat dir, single include path (see src/weirdike/PINNED_COMMIT).
file(GLOB WEIRDIKE_SRCS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/weirdike/*.c")

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "Homeserver_Autosetup_Modem_V1_USBHost.ino.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ipsec_service.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ipsec_runtime.cpp"
        ${WEIRDIKE_SRCS}
        "${APP_ROOT}/camera_manager.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/camera_stream_service.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ec200a_ecm.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ec200a_modem.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/esp32p4_camera_device.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/esp32s3_camera_device.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ui_diag.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ui_internet.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ui_kamera.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ui_overview.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ui_system.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/ui_wlan.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/web_ui.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/web_ui_assets.cpp"
        "${APP_ROOT}/web_ui_menu.cpp"
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "${APP_ROOT}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/weirdike"
    REQUIRES
        mbedtls lwip
)
